sequence_of_missions.name: d7-gate-run5
sequence_of_missions.purpose: First mission: default containerized worker (unrestricted --kinds), to test the live-model PATCH_GENERATE path first, per this task's own instruction.
sequence_of_missions.jobs: BASELINE SUCCEEDED (8/8 ctest) -> FUZZ SUCCEEDED (3729 execs, 1 crash, 0.3s) -> CORRELATE SUCCEEDED (1 finding) -> PATCH_GENERATE FAILED
sequence_of_missions.patch_generate_failure: HTTP Error 401: Unauthorized, from gateway.ollama.OllamaCodeLlamaBackend.generate() -> gateway.client.post_json() -> model-host-auth's nginx bearer-token gate (D-075/SEC-50). Root cause: orchestrator/patch_generate_executor.py::_build_live_backend() constructs OllamaCodeLlamaBackend(endpoint=...) without passing bearer_token=settings.model_host_bearer_token, even though GatewaySettings.model_host_bearer_token is populated correctly from the MODEL_HOST_BEARER_TOKEN env var (confirmed present and correct inside the worker container, and confirmed the identical token, sent manually via curl-equivalent urllib request from inside the same container, gets a real 200 from model-host). This is a NEW blocker, distinct from and downstream of D-098's blocker 1 (the IndexError), which D-103 fixed -- the IndexError no longer occurs; the gateway package now imports and executes inside the container, and reaches the model-host-auth sidecar, but with no Authorization header at all, so it is rejected before ever reaching Ollama.

blockers_found_this_run.summary: PATCH_GENERATE live-model path: model-host-auth bearer token never threaded through orchestrator/patch_generate_executor.py::_build_live_backend()
blockers_found_this_run.detail: See sequence_of_missions[0].patch_generate_failure above for the full root-cause trace. Confirmed the token itself is correct and reachable (manual curl-equivalent from inside the worker container succeeds with 200), so this is purely a call-site bug: GatewaySettings.model_host_bearer_token is computed correctly by gateway.settings.from_environment() but _build_live_backend() drops it when constructing OllamaCodeLlamaBackend, whose own bearer_token field and docstring exist specifically for this D-075/SEC-50 scenario.
blockers_found_this_run.owner: backend-developer (orchestrator/patch_generate_executor.py, the same module D-103 fixed the IndexError in)
blockers_found_this_run.fix_authority: explicitly out of this seat's authority per this project's standing rule against altering another role's application code to make it deploy; not fixed here, reported only.

blockers_found_this_run.summary: Reproducer/minimized-crash artifact persistence gap (D-098 recommendation 3) still open -- VERIFIED is structurally unreachable for a FUZZING_CAMPAIGN-discovered finding regardless of candidate correctness.

blockers_found_this_run.summary: A stale named pgdata volume from a prior session carried a POSTGRES_PASSWORD that no longer matched the current .env, crash-looping worker/command-center on password auth failure until fixed with a live ALTER ROLE.
blockers_found_this_run.status: Worked around live, non-destructively, this run. Not previously documented as a named gotcha in D-084/D-085/D-098's own gotcha list -- flagged here as a new environment note for the next rehearsal: a named Docker volume across sessions can silently disagree with a regenerated .env's POSTGRES_PASSWORD; either keep .env's Postgres credentials stable across a project's lifetime, or reset the volume, or ALTER ROLE as done here.
